about: iMEX shift calendar test vectors (docs/SHIFTS.md). Timestamps: ISO-8601; compare as instants. Instance fields not listed in an expectation are not checked. validate.expectCodes is compared as a sorted set of codes.

cases.name: Saturday-only shift, Friday night into Saturday, Sunday off
America/New_York 3x8: 7 h and 9 h night shifts
America/New_York shift starting inside the spring gap
America/New_York ambiguous boundary takes the first occurrence
Europe/Berlin 2x12 with breaks over both changes
Site inherit:true falls back to the organisation, then System Configuration
Machine override over the site, from a date
Holidays (union over the chain), year boundary
Empty chain; explicit zero-shift version does not inherit
America/New_York spring gap: a shift inside the gap is dropped and the night shift is cut (never overlapping)
America/New_York spring gap: a shift starting in the gap gives way to the next one (never overlapping)
Australia/Lord_Howe 30-minute spring gap: an empty shift is dropped, the night shift and its break are cut

same hours on different days are valid

Sunday night overlaps Monday early (week wrap)
